title: Hierarchical Log-Gaussian Relaxation on a Fixed D3Q125 Velocity Set
summary: We develop a hierarchical order-resolved relaxation model for a fixed D3Q125 discrete-velocity kinetic formulation. Conventional adaptive collision models often use one scalar rarefaction or nonequilibrium indicator for all retained moment orders, thereby coupling distinct kinetic sectors. Here, a shared macroscopic-gradient background is combined separately with second-, third-, and fourth-order thermodynamic nonequilibrium indicators to define effective measures K2, K3, and K4, each driving its own log-Gaussian relaxation spectrum.
